info.title: nusign
info.description: CLI for signing and verifying NuGet packages with PFX certificates and RFC3161 timestamps.

commands.name: generate-dev-cert
commands.description: Generate a self-signed dev certificate PFX.

options.name: --output-pfx
options.description: Target output path for generated PFX.

options.name: --password
options.description: PFX password.

options.name: --subject
options.description: Subject name. Default: CN=NuGet Package Signing (Dev).

options.name: --valid-days
options.description: Certificate validity in days. Default: 365.

options.name: --key-size
options.description: RSA key size. Minimum: 2048. Default: 3072.

options.name: --hash-algorithm
options.description: SHA256, SHA384, or SHA512. Default: SHA256.

options.name: --overwrite
options.description: Overwrite existing output file.

options.name: --json
options.description: Emit machine-readable JSON output.

options.name: --help
options.description: Show this help.

commands.name: sign
commands.description: Sign .nupkg/.snupkg artifacts using a PFX certificate.

options.name: --input
options.description: File or directory. Directories are scanned recursively.

options.name: --pfx-path
options.description: Path to certificate PFX file.

options.name: --pfx-password
options.description: Certificate password (avoid in shell history when possible).

options.name: --pfx-password-env
options.description: Environment variable for certificate password. Default: NUGET_SIGN_CERT_PASSWORD.

options.name: --timestamp-url
options.description: RFC3161 timestamp URL. Repeat to set fallback order.

options.name: --timestamp-url-file
options.description: --timestamp-timeout-seconds Timeout per sign attempt. Default: 15.

options.name: --timestamp-retries
options.description:
Retry count per URL before fallback. Default: 2.
--timestamp-retry-delay-ms Delay between retries per URL. Default: 500.

options.name: --hash-algorithm
options.description: SHA256, SHA384, or SHA512. Default: SHA256.

options.name: --overwrite
options.description: Overwrite existing signature if already signed.

options.name: --no-snupkg
options.description: Skip .snupkg files.

options.name: --json
options.description: Emit machine-readable JSON output.

options.name: --help
options.description: Show this help.

commands.name: verify
commands.description: Verify package signatures using strict trust validation.

options.name: --input
options.description: File or directory. Directories are scanned recursively.

options.name: --certificate-fingerprint
options.description: Pass-through fingerprint filter to dotnet nuget verify.

options.name: --configfile
options.description: Pass-through NuGet config file path.

options.name: --verbosity
options.description: Pass-through verbosity (q|m|n|d|diag).

options.name: --json
options.description: Emit machine-readable JSON output.

options.name: --help
options.description:
Show this help.
Notes:
verify uses strict trust-based validation and may fail for self-signed certificates (for example NU3018) by design.

options.name: --input
options.description: File or directory. Directories are scanned recursively.

options.name: --json
options.description: Emit machine-readable JSON output.

options.name: --help
options.description:
Show this help.
Notes:
verify-dev only checks signature presence (.signature.p7s). It does not perform trust-chain validation.
